「Lantern Mk2 是一款基於舊式禮拜堂飛船設計所改裝的小型船艦，配備了神父在為拯救新泰人員靈魂而進行的無盡戰鬥中可能需要的一切。」 Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries."
# 關於運行 LVHI Lantern Mk2 穿梭機的提示： - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]22 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - There are two buttons in the cockpit: the one with a yellow and black frame controls the window shutters. 那個帶有灰色邊框的按鈕用於切換推進器與陀螺儀。
- For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
